title: Korea Travel Info
subtitle: Not pinnable, but useful for your trip — curated tourism photos, Durunubi walking trails, audio guides, regional visitor stats, pet-friendly spots, and accessible-travel spots.

desc.photos: Tourism photos from the Korea Tourism Organization — sights, festivals, and landscapes. Search by place or keyword.
desc.trails: Durunubi Korea Dulle-gil walking courses (Haeparang, Namparang, Seohaerang, and the DMZ). Filter by brand and difficulty.
desc.audio: 'Odii' audio guides that narrate the history and stories behind Korea's attractions. Pick a place to open its stories.
desc.stats: Daily visitor counts by region (DataLab), estimated from telecom and card data. There's roughly a one-month lag before the latest data becomes available.
desc.pet: Lodging, dining, and attractions you can visit with a pet. Check each venue’s pet policy before you go.
desc.with: Barrier-free spots that are easier with a wheelchair or stroller. Accessibility details can differ by venue.
